title: Docker-first runtime and deploy stages
objective: Jobby product UI runs only from Compose on the host port in .ports.yml; host Next is refused unless an explicit escape is set.

requirements.statement: Product work starts Compose from deploy/docker-compose.yml and does not start a host Next process for jobby.
The only local web URL is http://127.0.0.1:<compose-web> from .ports.yml (compose-web is 4700). 3001 is not the recorded compose-web port.
scripts/web-ui.sh refuses to start unless JOBBY_ALLOW_HOST_NEXT=1.
Deploy stages are dev (local compose), stage (compose.qa or remote compose), and production (same Dockerfiles; Kubernetes later). This issue does not require cluster manifests.

scenarios.title: Compose serves the product on compose-web
given: deploy/docker-compose.yml is up with JOBBY_WEB_PORT from .ports.yml compose-web.
then: The response is HTTP 200 from the compose web service.
The recorded compose-web port is 4700, not 3001.

scenarios.title: Host Next is refused without the escape
then: The script exits without binding a host Next server.

scenarios.title: Explicit escape still starts host Next
then: The script is allowed to start as an emergency escape.

scenarios.title: Stage names are documented without requiring a cluster
scenarios.when: An agent picks a deploy stage.
then: dev, stage, and production are named.
Kubernetes manifests are not required to close #84.
